title: Parse a point
description:
Write `std::optional<Point> parsePoint(const std::string& text)` that understands text of the form `(3, 4)`: an opening bracket, a whole number, a comma, another whole number, a closing bracket. Spaces are allowed anywhere between the parts and at either end.

It returns `std::nullopt` for anything else, including extra characters after the closing bracket.

Read from a `std::istringstream`. Extracting into a `char` skips spaces and reads one character, which you can then compare with the one you expected. After the last part, check that nothing but spaces is left: `in >> std::ws; in.eof()`.
lessonTitle: Streams In Depth — istream, ostream, stringstream
